title: cloudflare speed cli: CLI for internet speed test via cloudflare
description:
Need to check your internet speed fast? Meet cloudflare-speed-cli — the command-line tool that tests your download and upload speeds in a TUI interface. It shows you real-time charts with download/upload throughput, idle latency, and loaded latency — all in one place.  No more guessing, just real data, real quick. Track results, export as JSON, and even script it!

https://github.com/kavehtehrani/cloudflare-speed-cli
